Chapter 7069: Headless Person

Chapter 7069: Headless Person

The ocean made from countless tribulations couldn’t endure Li Qiye’s weight.

“This does not bode well!” Heaven’s Demise shouted.

The ocean was everything, granting them their current indestructible state. How could the man destroy it with sheer weight alone?

“It’s falling.” The spectators could see the inevitable.

“Enough!” Suddenly, a shout caused the concaving ocean to erupt with violent waves. It became flattened again.

“Watch it!” Spectators retreated deeper into Dusk Realm upon feeling the shockwaves.

Unfortunately, the slower immortals were sent flying. A few overlords couldn’t scream before turning into blood.

The waves landed on Li Qiye but didn’t do any damage.

“Rumble!” The ocean's center cracked, revealing a bottomless abyss. Inside was a dao platform capable of storing the high heaven.

It was made of unknown materials and had numerous cracks. However, these cracks appeared to have been there naturally. It gave the impression of being the source of the tribulation ocean.

“Heaven Essence Platform, used to absorb the enforcer’s tribulations.” Heaven’s Equal became astounded.

During Heaven Pit, this artifact was placed in the center of creation. Rumor has it that it was built by Dusk and Heavenfall.

However, a few primordial immortals speculated that it came from Octopus and Hidden Immortal, the true masterminds.

According to the tales, the enforcer descended with endless tribulations, capable of punishing the attackers for epochs and destroying the nine major worlds.

However, Heaven Essence Platform was able to absorb it. This was their ace card. They believed that with it, the enforcer’s power would be halved.

While everyone examined the platform, Li Qiye noticed a person standing on top - a headless person wearing an ancient outfit.

“Oh?” Li Qiye had met this person before in Prime Ominous Grave.

“Who is that?” Others finally noticed the headless person.

The four celestial immortals and their allies in the ocean stared at this unknown being. Although they didn’t bow, it was clear they were awaiting instruction.

Even Heaven’s Equal didn’t recognize this cultivator.

“Is this Octopus?” An immortal asked.

“What does an octopus look like?” Someone shook her head.

“Then Hidden Immortal?” The immortal asked again.

“Perhaps.” No one had seen Hidden Immortal before but this headless being appeared to be in charge of the ocean.

“Where is the head? Perhaps Hidden Immortal also died from the battle?” Another speculated.

“Must be Heaven’s Incinerator.” Li Qiye startled the group with this comment.

“How do you know?!” Heaven’s Demise blurted.

“Just a guess that turns out to be true.” Li Qiye said.

“Haha, Incinerator is the true founder of Heaven Essence Alliance.” Zhao Dachui laughed.

“Just Octopus’ puppet.” Li Qiye smiled.

“We all come from the same sect, cultivating the Dao freely and traveling through the ages. How can you call us puppets?” Heaven’s Slayer didn’t appreciate the comment.
